    runFor

    • runFor(
          phase: "after-commit",
          host: EmapHostInternal,
          change: ValidationChange,
      ): Promise<ValidatorResult[]>

      Run every validator whose phase matches phase, in parallel. Validator throws are converted to severity: 'error' issues so the caller's hook chain stays predictable.

      Returns the per-validator results in registration order. Callers typically filter .report.ok === false to surface failures.

      Parameters

      • phase: "after-commit"

        phase accepts "after-commit" for runFor. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to "after-commit".

      • host: EmapHostInternal

        host accepts EmapHostInternal for runFor. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to EmapHostInternal.

      • change: ValidationChange

        change accepts ValidationChange for runFor. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to ValidationChange.

      Returns Promise<ValidatorResult[]>
